title: Towards Optimal Passive Feedback Control of LTI Systems under LQR Performance
summary: We study state-feedback design for continuous-time LTI systems with a control input and an external input-output pair. Our objective is to determine feedback gains that render the closed-loop system (strictly) passive with respect to the external port while minimizing the standard LQR cost in the disturbance-free case. The resulting constrained optimization problem is intractable due to bilinear matrix inequalities.
